reviews.title: Could use some improvement
reviews.text: I want so badly to give this app 5 stars. The puzzles and logic tests are absolutely phenomenal and it’s really fun to use. However, there are a few qualms I have. Firstly, immediately upon opening the app for the first time, you’re basically forced into a trial subscription, which you will inevitably forget to cancel, thus causing you to be charged $9.99 per WEEK thereafter!!! Regardless of how great the app is, $9.99 per week is just absurdly outrageous. This app is very reminiscent of Duolingo (an app I DO love and pay for, but I pay about $40 per YEAR), and I love that familiarity. I would subscribe to this app if the price were reasonable. It’s not, so unfortunately I will not be subscribing. My other qualms- when you take the basic IQ quizzes that are embedded in your learning path, it will tell you how many answers you got wrong, but it gives you no option to see WHICH answers were wrong, nor why. Also, ones you play/pass a level, there is no option to go back and re-do it. For all these reasons, I am giving this app 3 stars. I only recommend it if you have a lot of disposable income. I genuinely hope these things change so that I can come back to this app.
